name: Plate DCCLXXVII: The Sun Stone
description: The great stone of the Fifth Sun, Nahui Ollin: the four past worlds at its heart, the twenty day-signs in their ring, and two fire serpents carrying the sun across the sky. Struck in Obsidian Sun: obsidian, turquoise and gold, the stones of the Fifth Sun. One of the Seven Hierophants: a single plate, composed by hand, of which there is no other.
